title: Activity stamp
description: A red ink stamp marks each day in a four-week practice grid and keeps the total in sync.
useCase: Reversible daily completion with compact progress feedback.
interaction: Mark days; use arrows to move through the grid.
reducedMotion: Stamps appear immediately with no scale pulse.
limitations: A local 28-day practice grid, not a dated calendar or persisted habit service.
look: White panel with a monospace seven-column four-week grid where completed days are glossy red ink circles, plus a red serif tally and thin grey rules.
motion: Marking a day stamps a red circle down from 1.22× scale and 60% opacity to full size over 180 ms ease-out; unmarking and keyboard toggles change instantly.
adapt: The stamp is `@keyframes sf-as-press` (`scale(1.22)` to `scale(1)`, `180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1)`), applied through `data-stamp` to the day just marked in `toggle`. Replace `seed` and the 28-cell range with real dates, and persist `days`.
